dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Daiquiri, a handsome guy who gets sweeter the more you get to know him!

Daiquiri may first catch your eye with his tan merle coat and bright blue eyes, but his affectionate side is what really makes him special. As Daiquiri gets to know you, he’ll seek out more time together and may even lean right into your lap to soak up some pets. Treats are a great way to get Daiquiri engaged. He already knows “sit” and “paw” and is continuing to learn new things. When it’s time to unwind, give him a bully stick and he’s happy to settle in and relax. Spend a little time with Daiquiri and you may find him getting closer and closer, literally! Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Daiquiri’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: DAIQUIRI
